student_learning_goal: I can use data to predict an outcome.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use data to predict an outcome.
header.character_watermark: Sap Sam the Collector in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Use the rule '1 tree = 1 bucket'. Predict the buckets for each tree count.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four prediction rows with tree counts.

image_placeholders.description: Four prediction rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each row: '__ trees → __ buckets'. Tree counts pre-filled: 4, 7, 10, 12. Header 'Rule: 1 tree = 1 bucket. Predict:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_RULE1: keywords (predict, rule) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: New rule: '1 tree = 2 buckets'. Predict for each tree count.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four prediction rows with the new rule.

image_placeholders.description: Four prediction rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each row: '__ trees → __ buckets'. Tree counts pre-filled: 3, 5, 8, 10. Header 'Rule: 1 tree = 2 buckets. Predict:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_RULE2: keywords (new, rule) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a rule from YOUR day (1 sandwich = 2 slices, 1 friend = 1 hello). Make a prediction.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A rule line, prediction box, and drawing area.

image_placeholders.description: A blank rule line at the top in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Below: a prediction box and a small drawing area. Header 'My Real-Life Rule:'. Lines: 'My rule: ___' and 'My prediction: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_MY_RULE: keywords (my, rule) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Child writes a rule from their day and predicts an outcome.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, invent another rule and make 3 more predictions.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 worksheet practices C4 step 3 (predict). Watch for over-confident predictions ('always exactly 5 buckets') — flag for refinement in lesson 4.
